title: Thinking on Working in Partnership with Generative AI (GenAI)
summary: A few months after their first GenAI conversation, Kahran and Divya check in on where they're actually working alongside the tools — appraisal-writing in GPT, marketing copy variations, comic generation with Stable Diffusion, AI for surfacing drug candidates. They argue AI is best framed as a quirky collaborator slotted into hierarchies of curation rather than a coin-in coin-out machine.

intents.display: to figure out how to actually work in partnership with generative ai
